summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end verification complete. All 7 acceptance criteria pass: (1) Backend POST /api/predictions returns HTTP 400 detail='Tippning stängd' when kickoff <= now+5min, returns 200 when >5min in future — verified with two ephemeral matches (kickoff +3min and +10min) cleaned up afterward. (2) GET /api/predictions/match/{id} returns {locked: True, predictions: []} for non-admin users on unfinished matches — verified by creating a regular invite-only test user and hitting the endpoint. Admin bypass also verified. (3) GET /api/config/v1-deadline returns a seeded default value (year 2026). (4) Frontend Matches page: when kickoff is within 5 min, the 'locked-{id}' badge renders 'Tippning stängd' and pred-save-{id} disappears (verified by creating kickoff-in-3min match, navigating, asserting selectors, then deleting). For >5min matches, inputs + 'Spara' button + caption 'Tippning stänger 5 minuter före avspark' all render. (5) Tournament Prediction page: with deadline in the past, calm zinc banner 'Version 1 är stängd' shows and no 'PASSED'/'LATE' strings appear; with deadline restored to 2026-06-11T18:55Z (default), the yellow warning 'Version 1 stänger: 2026-06-11 20:55 (Europe/Stockholm)' appears. (6) Late flag preserved internally (POST /tournament-predictions returns is_late=true after past deadline) but no longer surfaced as 'LATE'/'PASSED' in UI. (7) Swedish UI text verified across Login (Kicka igång, E-post, Lösenord), Dashboard (Välkommen tillbaka, Placering, Livepoäng, Totalt, Skicka turneringstips, Kommande matcher, Gruppställning), Matches (Matcher, Spara, Se andras tips, Kommande/Spelade/Alla/Gruppspel/Slutspel, 'Tippning stänger 5 minuter före avspark'), Tournament (Turneringstips, Gruppspel — placering 1 till 4, 1:a/2:a/3:e/4:e, Välj lag, Spara Version 1 - visible as 'SPARA VERSION 1' via CSS uppercase), Leaderboard (Topplista, Totalpoäng, Livepoäng, Strategipoäng, Spelare), Bottom nav (Hem/Matcher/Topp/Tips/Admin - rendered as HEM/MATCHER/TOPP/TIPS/ADMIN via CSS uppercase). Regression confirmed: /api/matches returns 104 matches, /api/teams returns 48 teams, /api/leaderboard works, /api/auth/me works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1078 lines — getting large. Recommend extracting modules (auth, predictions, tournament, admin, scoring, import) into separate files in a future iteration. Not blocking.
server.py L343 lock check correctly uses now_utc() >= kickoff - timedelta(minutes=5); aligns 1:1 with frontend LOCK_OFFSET_MS = 5*60*1000 in Matches.jsx L8.

server.py L366 match_predictions_visible: non-admin gating now uses match.status == 'finished' (stricter than previous kickoff-based gate) — matches the iteration 4 spec exactly. Verified with a real non-admin user.
server.py L1031-1039 seeds default V1 deadline (2026-06-11T18:55:00+00:00 = 20:55 Europe/Stockholm) only when no config doc exists — idempotent, will not overwrite admin-set deadline on restart.

Matches.jsx correctly hides BOTH score inputs AND save button (lines 100-127 branch on `locked`) and shows 'Ditt tips' for users who already submitted, or 'Inget tips inskickat' otherwise — matches spec.

TournamentPrediction page renders Yellow warning 'Version 1 stänger' for future deadlines and a calm zinc 'Version 1 är stängd' for past — visually confirmed via screenshot on both states. No red banner, no 'PASSED'/'LATE' leaks.
Bottom nav and Spara button text use CSS uppercase — content in DOM is Swedish lowercase as required (Hem/Matcher/Topp/Tips/Admin, Spara Version 1).
